mission_02: Geometric transforms modify the spatial structure of images, creating variations that help models become invariant to position, scale, rotation, and distortion. ShiftScaleRotate randomly shifts, scales, and rotates images, simulating different camera positions and zoom levels. ElasticTransform applies non-rigid deformations that mimic natural variations, particularly useful in medical imaging. GridDistortion divides the image into a grid and displaces grid points, creating realistic warping effects. Together, these transforms significantly improve model robustness to geometric variations encountered in real-world data.
